`interface FileCacheWriter`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.cache` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FileCacheWriter.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/cache/FileCacheWriter.java)

Writes the content of a cache entry into the file it is given.

## Description

Pass it as a lambda to [`FileCacheArea.compute`](/reference/resources/filecachearea/#FileCacheArea-method-compute) or [`FileCacheArea.store`](/reference/resources/filecachearea/#FileCacheArea-method-store).

## Method details

<a id="FileCacheWriter-method-write"></a>

### write

`void write(File file)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

JOID calls it on the calling thread with a temporary path in the area: create that file, or a folder there, with the content of the entry.
Throw `IOException` on failure; the temporary file is then deleted and nothing is cached.
